mapper.select: SELECT x.*, p.code AS product_code, p.name AS product_name, m.code AS material_code, m.name AS material_name, m.spec, m.unit, m.batch_enabled, m.serial_enabled FROM mes_outsource_material x JOIN wms_material p ON p.id = x.product_id JOIN wms_material m ON m.id = x.material_id WHERE x.order_id = #{orderId} ORDER BY x.order_item_id, m.code
mapper.insert:
INSERT INTO mes_outsource_material (order_id, order_item_id, product_id, material_id, unit_qty, required_qty, issued_qty, returned_qty, consumed_qty, create_time, update_time) VALUES
(#{i.orderId}, #{i.orderItemId}, #{i.productId}, #{i.materialId}, #{i.unitQty}, #{i.requiredQty}, 0, 0, 0, NOW(), NOW())
mapper.update: UPDATE mes_outsource_material SET issued_qty = issued_qty + #{qty}, update_time = NOW() WHERE id = #{id}
UPDATE mes_outsource_material SET returned_qty = returned_qty + #{qty}, update_time = NOW() WHERE id = #{id} AND issued_qty - returned_qty - consumed_qty >= #{qty}
UPDATE mes_outsource_material SET consumed_qty = consumed_qty + #{qty}, update_time = NOW() WHERE id = #{id}
mapper.select: SELECT i.id AS "orderItemId", i.material_id AS "materialId", i.qty AS "qty" FROM scm_order_item i JOIN scm_order o ON o.id = i.order_id WHERE i.order_id = #{orderId} AND o.kind = 'PURCHASE' ORDER BY i.id
SELECT d.order_id AS "orderId", i.order_item_id AS "orderItemId", i.material_id AS "materialId", i.qty AS "qty" FROM scm_trade_doc_item i JOIN scm_trade_doc d ON d.id = i.doc_id WHERE d.id = #{docId}
